name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Heir goes with neither Fairfax nor Holloway.
Either Fairfax goes with Bathing or Writing goes with Ashford.
Between Painting and Walking, one goes with Ashford and the other with Gardener.
Butler does not go with Fairfax if and only if Painting goes with Fairfax.
Exactly one of these is true: Holloway goes with Bathing; Butler goes with Painting; Doctor goes with Walking.
